```{r load packages and data, include=FALSE}
library(DESeq2)
library(dplyr)

library(ggrepel)
library(pheatmap)
library(org.Hs.eg.db)
library(GOstats)

library(ggvenn)


counts <- read.table("data/exp2.counts", header = TRUE)
counts <- as.data.frame(counts)

gene_info <- counts[, 1:6]
counts <- counts[, 7:29]
counts$Geneid <- gene_info$Geneid
rownames(counts) <- counts$Geneid
counts <- subset(counts, select = -Geneid)
metadata <- read.csv("data/metadata_virus.csv")

```

```{r read counts, include=FALSE}

total_counts <- colSums(counts[, -1])


```


```{r DESeq object, include= FALSE}


# filter counts; genes with zero expression in every sample excluded
filtered_counts <- counts[rowSums(counts) > 0, ]

filtered_counts <- as.matrix(filtered_counts)

# 'filtered_counts_matrix' will now contain genes with non-zero counts in at least one sample

# add a small pseudocount to the counts, because rlog/vst does not work for 0 
pseudocount <- 1 # adjust as needed
counts_with_pseudocount <- filtered_counts + pseudocount

# copy the columns 1:3 and 19:23 to a new matrix
counts_with_pseudocount_24_A2 <- counts_with_pseudocount[, c(1:3, 21:23)]
counts_with_pseudocount_48_A2 <- counts_with_pseudocount[, c(7:9, 21:23)]
counts_with_pseudocount_72_A2 <- counts_with_pseudocount[, c(13:15, 21:23)]
counts_with_pseudocount_24_B3 <- counts_with_pseudocount[, c(4:6, 21:23)]
counts_with_pseudocount_48_B3 <- counts_with_pseudocount[, c(10:12, 21:23)]
counts_with_pseudocount_72_B3 <- counts_with_pseudocount[, c(16:18, 21:23)]
counts_with_pseudocounts_IFNB <- counts_with_pseudocount[, c(19:23)]

# do same for metadata
metadata_24_A2 <- metadata[c(1:3, 21:23), ]
metadata_48_A2 <- metadata[c(7:9, 21:23), ]
metadata_72_A2 <- metadata[c(13:15, 21:23), ]
metadata_24_B3 <- metadata[c(4:6, 21:23), ]
metadata_48_B3 <- metadata[c(10:12, 21:23), ]
metadata_72_B3 <- metadata[c(16:18, 21:23), ]
metadata_INFB <- metadata[c(19:23), ]

# create a list with the datasets and metadata
datasets <- list(counts_with_pseudocount_24_A2, 
                 counts_with_pseudocount_48_A2, 
                 counts_with_pseudocount_72_A2, 
                 counts_with_pseudocount_24_B3, 
                 counts_with_pseudocount_48_B3, 
                 counts_with_pseudocount_72_B3,
                 counts_with_pseudocounts_IFNB)
metadata_list <- list(metadata_24_A2, 
                      metadata_48_A2, 
                      metadata_72_A2, 
                      metadata_24_B3, 
                      metadata_48_B3, 
                      metadata_72_B3, 
                      metadata_INFB)
# add names to the list
names(datasets) <- c("Condition_A2_Time_24", "Condition_A2_Time_48", "Condition_A2_Time_72", "Condition_B3_Time_24", "Condition_B3_Time_48", "Condition_B3_Time_72", "Condition_IFNB")

# loop through the list and create a deseqdataset for each dataset
for (i in 1:length(datasets)) {
  datasets[[i]] <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = datasets[[i]],
                              colData = metadata_list[[i]],
                              design = ~ condition)
}

# differential gene expression analysis for each dataset
for (i in 1:length(datasets)) {
  datasets[[i]] <- DESeq(datasets[[i]])
}
```

# Differential gene expression analysis results for INFB vs mock are plotted below. The plot shows the log2FoldChange vs baseMean for each gene. The genes that are most upregulated in the INFB condition are labelled. The genes are also colored in a scale for p-value. 
```{r logFC vs base mean, echo=FALSE, fig.width=7, fig.height=7, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# load data

results <- results_list$Condition_IFNB
results <- as.data.frame(results)
results$gene_id <- rownames(results)

# Specify genes to label
genes_to_label <- c("OAS1", "OAS3", "IFITM1", "ISG15", rownames(head(results[order(results$log2FoldChange),], 5)))

# Create the plot
p <- ggplot(results) +
  geom_point(aes(x = log2FoldChange, y = log2(baseMean), color = results$padj), size = 1) +
  labs(x = "log2FoldChange", y = "baseMean") + 
  labs(color = "Adjusted p-value: ") + 
  ggtitle("log2FoldChange vs baseMean in mock vs INFB") +
  theme(
    legend.key.width = unit(1, "cm"),  
    legend.key.height = unit(0.5, "cm"),  
    legend.text = element_text(size = 4),  
    legend.title = element_text(size = 5),
    plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0)  # Adjust the caption position
  ) 


# Add labels for specific genes
p <- p + geom_text_repel(data = results[results$gene_id %in% genes_to_label, ],
                         aes(x = log2FoldChange,
                             y = log2(baseMean),
                             label = gene_id),
                         box.padding = 0.5,
                         force = 1,
                         segment.color = "green",
                         segment.size = 0.2)
print(p)

```

```{r make dataset with normalized counts for DEGs, echo=FALSE}
process_results <- function(results, padj_threshold = 0.01, log2fc_threshold = 1.5) {
  results <- results[!is.na(results$padj) &
                     results$padj < padj_threshold &
                     (results$log2FoldChange < -log2fc_threshold |
                      results$log2FoldChange > log2fc_threshold), ]
  return(as.data.frame(results))
}

process_all_results <- function(results_list, condition_prefix, time_points, padj_threshold = 0.01, log2fc_threshold = 1.5) {
  results <- lapply(time_points, function(time_point) {
    results <- results_list[[paste0(condition_prefix, "_Time_", time_point)]]
    return(process_results(results, padj_threshold, log2fc_threshold))
  })
  return(results)
}

# Process results for condition A2
results_A2 <- process_all_results(results_list, "Condition_A2", c(24, 48, 72))

# Process results for condition B3
results_B3 <- process_all_results(results_list, "Condition_B3", c(24, 48, 72))

unique_genes <- unique(c(rownames(results_A2[[1]]), rownames(results_A2[[2]]),
                         rownames(results_A2[[3]]), rownames(results_B3[[1]]),
                         rownames(results_B3[[2]]), rownames(results_B3[[3]]))) %>% as.data.frame()


# extract counts from deseq datasets
counts_A2_24 <- counts(datasets$Condition_A2_Time_24, normalized = TRUE)
counts_A2_48 <- counts(datasets$Condition_A2_Time_48, normalized = TRUE)
counts_A2_72 <- counts(datasets$Condition_A2_Time_72, normalized = TRUE)
counts_B3_24 <- counts(datasets$Condition_B3_Time_24, normalized = TRUE)
counts_B3_48 <- counts(datasets$Condition_B3_Time_48, normalized = TRUE)
counts_B3_72 <- counts(datasets$Condition_B3_Time_72, normalized = TRUE)
counts_infb <- counts(datasets$Condition_IFNB, normalized = TRUE)

# calculate mean for mock and A3
mock <- rowMeans(counts_A2_24[, 4:6])
mock <- as.data.frame(mock)
colnames(mock) <- "mock"

A2_24 <- rowMeans(counts_A2_24[, 1:3])
A2_24 <- as.data.frame(A2_24)
colnames(A2_24) <- "24"

A2_48 <- rowMeans(counts_A2_48[, 1:3])
A2_48 <- as.data.frame(A2_48)
colnames(A2_48) <- "48"

A2_72 <- rowMeans(counts_A2_72[, 1:3])
A2_72 <- as.data.frame(A2_72)
colnames(A2_72) <- "72"

B3_24 <- rowMeans(counts_B3_24[, 1:3])
B3_24 <- as.data.frame(B3_24)
colnames(B3_24) <- "24"

B3_48 <- rowMeans(counts_B3_48[, 1:3])
B3_48 <- as.data.frame(B3_48)
colnames(B3_48) <- "48"

B3_72 <- rowMeans(counts_B3_72[, 1:3])
B3_72 <- as.data.frame(B3_72)
colnames(B3_72) <- "72"

# create table with genes as rows, mean counts as cols: mock, 24, 48, 72
unique_genes$mock <- mock$mock[match(unique_genes$.,
                                                          rownames(A2_24))]
unique_genes$"A2_24h" <- A2_24$"24"[match(unique_genes$.,
                                                          rownames(A2_24))]
unique_genes$"A2_48h" <- A2_48$"48"[match(unique_genes$.,
                                                          rownames(A2_48))]
unique_genes$"A2_72h" <- A2_72$"72"[match(unique_genes$.,
                                                          rownames(A2_72))]
unique_genes$"B3_24h" <- B3_24$"24"[match(unique_genes$.,
                                                          rownames(B3_24))]
unique_genes$"B3_48h" <- B3_48$"48"[match(unique_genes$.,
                                                          rownames(B3_48))]
unique_genes$"B3_72h" <- B3_72$"72"[match(unique_genes$.,
                                                          rownames(B3_72))]

rownames(unique_genes) <- unique_genes$.
unique_genes <- unique_genes[, -1]

```

# The counts of differentially expressed genes (DEGs) are plotted in the charts below. The counts are normalized and averaged for each time point. The first chart shows counts and the second percentage of up- and downregulated genes.


```{r overview of DEGs, echo =  FALSE}

# dataframes with upregulated genes
down_A2 <- results_A2[[1]][results_A2[[1]]$log2FoldChange > 1.5, ]
down_A2_1 <- results_A2[[2]][results_A2[[2]]$log2FoldChange > 1.5, ]
down_A2_2 <- results_A2[[3]][results_A2[[3]]$log2FoldChange > 1.5, ]
down_B3 <- results_B3[[1]][results_B3[[1]]$log2FoldChange > 1.5, ]
down_B3_1 <- results_B3[[2]][results_B3[[2]]$log2FoldChange > 1.5, ]
down_B3_2 <- results_B3[[3]][results_B3[[3]]$log2FoldChange > 1.5, ]

# dataframes with downregulated genes
up_A2 <- results_A2[[1]][results_A2[[1]]$log2FoldChange < -1.5, ]
up_A2_1 <- results_A2[[2]][results_A2[[2]]$log2FoldChange < -1.5, ]
up_A2_2 <- results_A2[[3]][results_A2[[3]]$log2FoldChange < -1.5, ]
up_B3 <- results_B3[[1]][results_B3[[1]]$log2FoldChange < -1.5, ]
up_B3_1 <- results_B3[[2]][results_B3[[2]]$log2FoldChange < -1.5, ]
up_B3_2 <- results_B3[[3]][results_B3[[3]]$log2FoldChange < -1.5, ]

# common upregulated genes
up_shared <- data.frame(intersect(rownames(up_A2), rownames(up_B3)))
up_shared_1 <- data.frame(intersect(rownames(up_A2_1), rownames(up_B3_1)))
up_shared_2 <- data.frame(intersect(rownames(up_A2_2), rownames(up_B3_2)))
# common downregulated genes
down_shared <- data.frame(intersect(rownames(down_A2), rownames(down_B3)))
down_shared_1 <- data.frame(intersect(rownames(down_A2_1), rownames(down_B3_1)))
down_shared_2 <- data.frame(intersect(rownames(down_A2_2), rownames(down_B3_2)))


# Create dataframe per timepoint, with the number of upregulated and downregulated genes
degs_24 <- data.frame(A2 = c(nrow(down_A2), nrow(up_A2)),
                      common = c(nrow(down_shared), nrow(up_shared)),
                      B3 = c(nrow(down_B3), nrow(up_B3)))

degs_48 <- data.frame(A2 = c(nrow(down_A2_1), nrow(up_A2_1)),
                      common = c(nrow(down_shared_1), nrow(up_shared_1)),
                      B3 = c(nrow(down_B3_1), nrow(up_B3_1)))

degs_72 <- data.frame(A2 = c(nrow(down_A2_2), nrow(up_A2_2)),
                      common = c(nrow(down_shared_2), nrow(up_shared_2)),
                      B3 = c(nrow(down_B3_2), nrow(up_B3_2)))

degs_24$regulation <- c("down", "up")
degs_48$regulation <- c("down", "up")
degs_72$regulation <- c("down", "up")

fractions_24 <- sweep(degs_24[, 1:3], 2, colSums(degs_24[, 1:3]), "/")
fractions_48 <- sweep(degs_48[, 1:3], 2, colSums(degs_48[, 1:3]), "/")
fractions_72 <- sweep(degs_72[, 1:3], 2, colSums(degs_72[, 1:3]), "/")

fractions_24$regulation <- degs_24$regulation
fractions_48$regulation <- degs_48$regulation
fractions_72$regulation <- degs_72$regulation

combined <- rbind(cbind(degs_24, time = "24h"), cbind(degs_48, time = "48h"), cbind(degs_72, time = "72h"))
# convert to percentage up and down
combined_long <- melt(combined, id.vars = c("time", "regulation"))

combined_long$regulation <- factor(combined_long$regulation, levels = c("up", "down"))

ggplot(combined_long, aes(x = variable, y = value, fill = regulation)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "stack") +
  labs(
    title = "Number of differentially expressed genes",
    x = "Time and Virus", y = "Count", fill = "Regulation") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("down" = "cornflowerblue", "up" = "indianred2")) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
  facet_wrap(~time)  
#  theme(panel.margin = grid::unit(1.25, "lines"))

# same plot but with percentage
combined_fraction <- rbind(cbind(fractions_24, time = "24h"), cbind(fractions_48, time = "48h"), cbind(fractions_72, time = "72h"))

combined_fraction_long <- melt(combined_fraction, id.vars = c("time", "regulation"))

# add actual counts to bars
# should the A2 an B3 bars only include unique genes or all signiifcant genes?
combined_fraction_long$regulation <- factor(combined_fraction_long$regulation, levels = c("up", "down"))

ggplot(combined_fraction_long, aes(x = variable, y = value, fill = regulation)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "stack") +
  labs(
    title = "Percentage of up- or downregulated genes per timepoint in A2 and B3",
    x = "Time and Virus", y = "Percentage", fill = "Regulation") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("down" = "cornflowerblue", "up" = "indianred2")) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
  facet_wrap(~time)

```

```{r pc analysis, include = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}

# extract normalized coutns from each dataset, add them to single matrix

#normalized_counts_list <- lapply(datasets[[i]], function(x) counts(x, normalized = TRUE))
#combined_normalized_counts <- Reduce(function(x, y) cbind(x, y), normalized_counts_list)

# normalize raw counts by library size
counts_normalized <- t(t(counts) / colSums(counts) * 10000)


# exclude the genes in the labeled_genes vector
#counts_normalized <- counts_normalized[!rownames(counts_normalized) %in% labeled_genes, ]

# PCA
pca <- prcomp(t(counts_normalized)) 
# Find the proportion of variance explained by each PC
pca_summary <- summary(pca)$importance
pca_summary

# Create data frame with metadata and the PCA values for plotting
pca$x <- as.data.frame(pca$x)
pca_plotting <- cbind(metadata, pca$x ) 
pca_plotting <- as.data.frame(pca_plotting)

# Obtain the percentages of variation covered by PC1 and PC2 etc
PC1_var <- round(pca_summary["Proportion of Variance", "PC1"]*100, digits = 1)
PC2_var <- round(pca_summary["Proportion of Variance", "PC2"]*100, digits = 1)
PC3_var <- round(pca_summary["Proportion of Variance", "PC3"]*100, digits = 1)




```

# Principal components analysis was conducted for all of the samples. First, the main PC's and the proportion of variance they explain are shown. 


```{r pca summary, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
# Plot the variance explained by each PC
pca_summary <- as.data.frame(pca_summary)

pca_comp_var <- pca_summary[2, 1:9 ]

pca_summary_long <- pivot_longer(pca_comp_var, cols = colnames(pca_comp_var))


comp_var <- ggplot(pca_summary_long) +
  geom_point(aes(x = pca_summary_long$name, y = pca_summary_long$value), size = 2, alpha = 0.7) +
  ggtitle("components vs variance") +
  xlab(paste0("Principal Component")) +
  ylab(paste0("Proportion of Variance")) +
  theme_minimal()

ggsave("data/plots/pca_comp_var.png", comp_var, width = 7, height = 5, units = "in", dpi = 300)

print(comp_var)

# geom_line(aes(x = pca_summary_long$name, y = pca_summary_long$value), color = "grey")

```

```{r new heatmap, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
# merge deseq normalized counts objects

                      counts_infb[, 1:2])

# rearrange for mock to come first and infb last
deseq_counts <- deseq_counts[, c(4:6, 1:3, 7:23)]

# subset with significant gene
# Assuming unique_genes contains the significant gene names
sig_genes <- as.character(rownames(unique_genes))

# Subsetting deseq_counts to include only significant genes
deseq_counts_subset <- deseq_counts[sig_genes, , drop = FALSE]
deseq_counts_scaled <- t(scale(t(deseq_counts_subset)))

# trim from the colnames 1Aligned.out.bam
colnames(deseq_counts_scaled) <- gsub("_1Aligned.out.bam", "", colnames(deseq_counts_scaled))

# new dataframe with for each sample group, check in the deseq dataset 
# if p is < 0.01 and log2FoldChange > 1.5 or < -1.5
# if yes, put 1, if no, put 0
deseq_counts_summary <- data.frame(
  A2_24H = ifelse(results_list[["Condition_A2_Time_24"]]$padj < 0.01 &
                  abs(results_list[["Condition_A2_Time_24"]]$log2FoldChange) > 1.5, 1, 0),
  A2_48H = ifelse(results_list[["Condition_A2_Time_48"]]$padj < 0.01 &
                  abs(results_list[["Condition_A2_Time_48"]]$log2FoldChange) > 1.5, 1, 0),
  A2_72H = ifelse(results_list[["Condition_A2_Time_72"]]$padj < 0.01 &
                  abs(results_list[["Condition_A2_Time_72"]]$log2FoldChange) > 1.5, 1, 0),
  B3_24H = ifelse(results_list[["Condition_B3_Time_24"]]$padj < 0.01 &
                  abs(results_list[["Condition_B3_Time_24"]]$log2FoldChange) > 1.5, 1, 0),
  B3_48H = ifelse(results_list[["Condition_B3_Time_48"]]$padj < 0.01 & 
                  abs(results_list[["Condition_B3_Time_48"]]$log2FoldChange) > 1.5, 1, 0),
  B3_72H = ifelse(results_list[["Condition_B3_Time_72"]]$padj < 0.01 & 
                  abs(results_list[["Condition_B3_Time_72"]]$log2FoldChange) > 1.5, 1, 0),
  INFB = ifelse(results_list[["Condition_IFNB"]]$padj < 0.01 & 
                  abs(results_list[["Condition_IFNB"]]$log2FoldChange) > 1.5, 1, 0))

# add rownames to the summary dataframe
rownames(deseq_counts_summary) <- rownames(results_list[["Condition_A2_Time_24"]])
# replace NA with 0
deseq_counts_summary[is.na(deseq_counts_summary)] <- 0
# subset to include only genes that are in deseq_counts_scaled
deseq_counts_summary <- deseq_counts_summary[sig_genes, , drop = FALSE]

saveRDS(deseq_counts_summary, "data/deseq_counts_summary.rds")
saveRDS(deseq_counts_scaled, "data/deseq_counts_scaled.rds")
```

# 3 clusters were extracted from the second heatmap. The following graphs show the relative gene expression for each cluster as a function of time. 

```{r clustergraphs, echo=FALSE, fig.width=4, fig.height=3}
# Create a list to store the long-format data frames
long_format_clusters <- list()

# Loop through each cluster
for (i in 1:length(clusters_list)) {
  # Subset the data for the current cluster
  current_cluster <- get(paste0("cluster_", i))
  current_cluster <- as.data.frame(current_cluster)

  # Calculate the mean expression for the current cluster
  cluster_mean_A2 <- rowMeans(current_cluster[, 1:4])
  cluster_stdev_A2 <- apply(current_cluster[, 1:4], 1, sd)
  
  current_cluster_A2 <- current_cluster[, 1:4]

  # Calculate relative gene expression by subtracting the cluster mean
  current_cluster_A2 <- (current_cluster_A2 - cluster_mean_A2) / cluster_stdev_A2
  #current_cluster_A2 <- sapply(current_cluster_A2, 
                                   #function(x) ifelse(x < -3, -3, 
                                                      #ifelse(x > 3, 3, x)))
  
  colnames(current_cluster_A2) <- c("mock", "24h", "48h", "72h")

  # Convert the current cluster to long format
  current_cluster_long_A2 <- tidyr::pivot_longer(current_cluster_A2, 
    cols = c("mock", "24h", "48h", "72h"),
    names_to = "timepoint", values_to = "relative_expression"
  )
  
  # Add a column to store gene names
  current_cluster_long_A2$gene <- rep(rownames(current_cluster_A2), each = 4) # Repeat each gene name for the 4 timepoints
  
  # Reorder the levels of the "timepoint" factor to have "mock" first
  current_cluster_long_A2$timepoint <- factor(current_cluster_long_A2$timepoint, levels = c("mock", "24h", "48h", "72h"))

  # Create a ggplot for the current cluster
  plot_A2 <- ggplot(current_cluster_long_A2, aes(x = timepoint,
                                           y = relative_expression,
                                           group = gene,
                                           color = gene)) +
    geom_point() +
    geom_line() +
    labs(title = paste0("A2 Cluster ", i)) +
    labs(x = "Timepoint", y = "z-score") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none"
    )

  # Show the plot
  print(plot_A2)
  
  cluster_mean_B3 <- rowMeans(current_cluster[, c(1, 5:7)])
  cluster_stdev_B3 <- apply(current_cluster[, c(1, 5:7)], 1, sd)
  
  current_cluster_B3 <- current_cluster[, c(1, 5:7)]
  
  # Calculate relative gene expression by subtracting the cluster mean
  current_cluster_B3 <- (current_cluster_B3 - cluster_mean_B3) / cluster_stdev_B3
  #current_cluster_B3 <- sapply(current_cluster_B3, 
                                   #function(x) ifelse(x < -3, -3, 
                                                     # ifelse(x > 3, 3, x)))
  
  colnames(current_cluster_B3) <- c("mock", "24h", "48h", "72h")
  
  # Convert the current cluster to long format
  current_cluster_long_B3 <- tidyr::pivot_longer(current_cluster_B3, 
    cols = c("mock", "24h", "48h", "72h"),
    names_to = "timepoint", values_to = "relative_expression"
  )
  
  # Add a column to store gene names
  current_cluster_long_B3$gene <- rep(rownames(current_cluster_B3), each = 4) # Repeat each gene name for the 4 timepoints
  
  # Reorder the levels of the "timepoint" factor to have "mock" first
  current_cluster_long_B3$timepoint <- factor(current_cluster_long_B3$timepoint, levels = c("mock", "24h", "48h", "72h"))
  
  # Create a ggplot for the current cluster
  plot_B3 <- ggplot(current_cluster_long_B3, aes(x = timepoint,
                                              y = relative_expression,
                                              group = gene,
                                              color = gene)) +
    geom_point() +
    geom_line() +
    labs(title = paste0("B3 Cluster ", i)) +
    labs(x = "Timepoint", y = "z-score") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none"
    )
  
  # Show the plot
  print(plot_B3)
}
```

```{r GO term enrichment, include=FALSE}

# create object with all the gene names in dataset for universe
all_genes <- rownames(counts)
all_genes <- mapIds(org.Hs.eg.db, ## convert gene ids to Entrez IDs
                    keys = all_genes, 
                    column = "ENTREZID", 
                    keytype = "SYMBOL")

# create list to store go term analysis results
goterm_results <- list()

# go term enrichment analysis for every cluster in the cluster list
for (i in 1:length(clusters_list)) {
  # object with names of all significant genes
  sign_genes <- rownames(clusters_list[[i]])
  
  # convert gene IDs to Entrez IDs
  sign_genes <- mapIds(org.Hs.eg.db, 
                          keys = sign_genes,
                          column = "ENTREZID", 
                          keytype = "SYMBOL")
  

  # Perform GO term enrichment analysis
  test_object <- new("GOHyperGParams",
                        geneIds = sign_genes,
                        universeGeneIds = all_genes, 
                        annotation = "org.Hs.eg.db", 
                        ontology = "BP", 
                        pvalueCutoff = 1,
                        testDirection = "over")
  
  # save current results in the list
  goterm_results[[i]] <- hyperGTest(test_object)
  }
```

# For every cluster, GO term enrichment analysis is performed. Top 20 most enriched GO terms in each of the clusters are shown in the figures below. 


```{r visual goterms, echo=FALSE, fig.width=8, fig.height=5, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Define a function to visualize GO enrichment results for multiple clusters
visualize_GO_enrichment <- function(goterm_results, title_prefix, save_path = NULL) {
  summary <- summary(goterm_results)
  summary <- summary %>% filter(Count > 5) %>% filter(Count < 500)
  
  summary$padj <- p.adjust(summary$Pvalue, method = "BH")
  
  # Select the top 20 GO terms
  goterm_top20 <- summary[order(summary$padj)[1:20],]

  # Plot the p-values of the top 20 GO terms
  goterm_top20$Term <- factor(goterm_top20$Term, 
                              levels = goterm_top20$Term[order(goterm_top20$padj, decreasing = TRUE)])
  
  # Print the summary results
  #print(summary(goterm_results))

  # Plot the visualization
  plot_obj <- ggplot(goterm_top20, aes(x = Term, y = -log10(padj))) +
    geom_point() +
    coord_flip() +
    ylab(expression(-log[10](adjusted~italic(P)~value))) + 
    ggtitle(title_prefix) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 14),
          axis.title.x = element_text(size = 12),
          axis.title.y = element_blank(),
          plot.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"))

  # Display the plot
  print(plot_obj)

  # Save the plot if a save path is provided
  if (!is.null(save_path)) {
    ggsave(file.path("data/plots/", save_path), plot_obj, width = 12, height = 6)
  }
}

# Visualize results for each cluster in WT
for (i in seq_along(goterm_results)) {
  visualize_GO_enrichment(goterm_results[[i]], paste("Cluster", i),
                          save_path = paste("GOterms_Cluster_", i, ".png", sep = ""))
}





```

```{r compare INFB with virus infection t24, echo=FALSE, fig.width=8, fig.height=5, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
upregulated_INFB <- results_INFB[!is.na(results_INFB$padj) &

downregulated_INFB <- results_INFB[!is.na(results_INFB$padj) &
```

```{r compare INFB with virus infection t72, echo=FALSE, fig.width=8, fig.height=5, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
venn_downregulated + ggtitle("Downregulated genes in INFB and A2, B3 (t=72) virus infection")


goterm_results_72 <- list()

# go term enrichment analysis for every cluster in the cluster list
for (i in 1:length(list_genes)) {
  # object with names of all significant genes
  sign_genes <- list_genes[[i]]
  
  # convert gene IDs to Entrez IDs
  sign_genes <- mapIds(org.Hs.eg.db, 
                          keys = sign_genes,
                          column = "ENTREZID", 
                          keytype = "SYMBOL")
  

  # Perform GO term enrichment analysis
  test_object <- new("GOHyperGParams",
                        geneIds = sign_genes,
                        universeGeneIds = all_genes, 
                        annotation = "org.Hs.eg.db", 
                        ontology = "BP", 
                        pvalueCutoff = 1,
                        testDirection = "over")
  
  # save current results in the list
  goterm_results_72[[i]] <- hyperGTest(test_object)
}

# add names to the list
names(goterm_results_72) <- names(list_genes)

for (i in seq_along(goterm_results_72)) {
  visualize_GO_enrichment(goterm_results_72[[i]], paste(names(goterm_results_72)[i], sep = " "),
                          save_path = paste(i, ".png", sep = ""))
}
```

```{r attempt to compress code, eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
# Define a function to generate Venn diagrams
generate_venn <- function(upregulated, downregulated, title_up, title_down) {
  venn_upregulated <- ggvenn(list("A2" = rownames(upregulated$A2),
                                   "B3" = rownames(upregulated$B3),
                                   "INFB" = rownames(upregulated$INFB)), 
                             fill_color = c("lightblue", "lightgreen", "lightpink"))
  
  venn_downregulated <- ggvenn(list("A2" = rownames(downregulated$A2),
                                     "B3" = rownames(downregulated$B3),
                                     "INFB" = rownames(downregulated$INFB)), 
                               fill_color = c("lightblue", "lightgreen", "lightpink"))
  
  venn_upregulated + ggtitle(title_up)
  venn_downregulated + ggtitle(title_down)
}

# Define a function to perform GO term enrichment analysis
perform_go_enrichment <- function(sign_genes) {
  sign_genes <- mapIds(org.Hs.eg.db, 
                        keys = sign_genes,
                        column = "ENTREZID", 
                        keytype = "SYMBOL")
  
  test_object <- new("GOHyperGParams",
                     geneIds = sign_genes,
                     universeGeneIds = all_genes, 
                     annotation = "org.Hs.eg.db", 
                     ontology = "BP", 
                     pvalueCutoff = 1,
                     testDirection = "over")
  
  hyperGTest(test_object)
}

# Define a function to visualize GO term enrichment
visualize_go_enrichment <- function(goterm_results, name) {
  visualize_GO_enrichment(goterm_results, name, save_path = paste(name, ".png", sep = ""))
}

# Loop over different time points
for (time_point in c("24", "48", "72")) {
  results_A2 <- results_list[[paste("A2_", time_point, sep = "")]]
  results_B3 <- results_list[[paste("B3_", time_point, sep = "")]]
  
  upregulated_A2 <- lapply(results_A2, function(result) result[!is.na(result$padj) &
                                                               result$padj < 0.01 &
                                                               result$log2FoldChange < -1.5, ])
  
  downregulated_A2 <- lapply(results_A2, function(result) result[!is.na(result$padj) &
                                                                 result$padj < 0.01 &
                                                                 result$log2FoldChange > 1.5, ])
  
  upregulated_B3 <- lapply(results_B3, function(result) result[!is.na(result$padj) &
                                                               result$padj < 0.01 &
                                                               result$log2FoldChange < -1.5, ])
  
  downregulated_B3 <- lapply(results_B3, function(result) result[!is.na(result$padj) &
                                                                 result$padj < 0.01 &
                                                                 result$log2FoldChange > 1.5, ])
  
  upregulated_INFB <- results_list$Condition_IFNB[!is.na(results_list$Condition_IFNB$padj) &
                                                   results_list$Condition_IFNB$padj < 0.01 &
                                                   results_list$Condition_IFNB$log2FoldChange < -1.5, ]
  
  downregulated_INFB <- results_list$Condition_IFNB[!is.na(results_list$Condition_IFNB$padj) &
                                                     results_list$Condition_IFNB$padj < 0.01 &
                                                     results_list$Condition_IFNB$log2FoldChange > 1.5, ]
  
  venn_titles <- c(paste("Upregulated genes in INFB and A2, B3 (t=", time_point, ") virus infection", sep = ""),
                   paste("Downregulated genes in INFB and A2, B3 (t=", time_point, ") virus infection", sep = ""))
  
  generate_venn(upregulated = list(A2 = upregulated_A2[[1]], B3 = upregulated_B3[[1]], INFB = upregulated_INFB),
                downregulated = list(A2 = downregulated_A2[[1]], B3 = downregulated_B3[[1]], INFB = downregulated_INFB),
                title_up = venn_titles[1],
                title_down = venn_titles[2])
  
  list_genes <- list(A2_up = rownames(upregulated_A2[[1]]),
                     A2_down = rownames(downregulated_A2[[1]]),
                     B3_up = rownames(upregulated_B3[[1]]),
                     B3_down = rownames(downregulated_B3[[1]]),
                     INFB_up = rownames(upregulated_INFB),
                     INFB_down = rownames(downregulated_INFB))
  
  goterm_results <- lapply(list_genes, perform_go_enrichment)
  names(goterm_results) <- names(list_genes)
  
  for (i in seq_along(goterm_results)) {
    visualize_go_enrichment(goterm_results[[i]], paste(names(goterm_results)[i], "_t_", time_point, sep = ""))
  }
}
```
